versions.changelog:
Google Autoreply Onboarding Skill — Initial Release

- Enables end-to-end onboarding for merchants to Auto Google Review Reply.
- Handles account register/login, Google Business Profile connection, and AI auto-reply configuration.
- Includes automatic 5-day free trial on first shop creation; no upfront payment required.
- Incorporates secure token handling, SSO handoff authentication, and membership status checks.
- Guides merchants step-by-step, gathering required information and confirming each onboarding phase.
